Marinated Burgers
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, April 6, 2010 - 12:44am

Ingredients




1 pound Ground beef
Cajun-Style Marinade see * Note

Preparation

1 Shape ground beef into 4 patties; place in large shallow dish. Pour Cajun-Style Marinade over burgers; turn to coat well. Cover; refrigerate several hours or overnight, turning occasionally. 2 Grill 4 inches from source of heat 5 minutes or until desired doneness, turning once and brushing frequently with marinade. 3 This recipe yields 4 servings.
